name: Angela A. Stout
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Houston, Texas
education: South Texas College of Law Houston
about: Angela Stout was board certified in family law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in 2015. She practices exclusively in family law and is experienced in all types of family-related legal matters. From divorce to child custody and child support, Angela Stout is dedicated to helping you organize and maintain your family's assets. Her law office is located in Houston, TX and she serves clients throughout the area.

Angela Stout is active in the legal community serving on the Board of Directors for the Family Law Section of the Houston Bar Association as well as the Board of Directors for Gulf Coast Family Law Specialists. She is a member of Burta Rhoads Raborn Family Law American Inn of Court and Ms. Stout also serves on the Advisory Committee for the American Bar Association Children's Immigration Law Academy (CILA). Ms. Stout has also issued publications and spoken at numerous legal education seminars.
honors: President's Award, Houston Bar Association Family Law Section , President's Award , Houston Bar Association
